user.title: Add a room
user.description: ThermalTwin learns how this room heats up and cools down from your existing sensors. Nothing is controlled, it only creates prediction entities.

data_description.target_temperature: Time-to-target predictions refer to this temperature, e.g. 19 °C as lower limit in winter or 28 °C as upper limit in a hot climate.
data_description.hvac_entity: Periods with heating or cooling active are learned separately. A climate entity reports heating/cooling itself; for a switch or plug choose the type below.
data_description.window_sensors: Periods with an open window are ignored for learning.
data_description.comfort_max: Creates a ventilation sensor that turns on when the room is warmer than this and outside is cooler.
